suggestion.description: Hayabusa was a JAXA mission that launched in 2003 and reached the near-Earth asteroid Itokawa in 2005. Despite many technical setbacks, it returned a capsule containing tiny grains of the asteroid to Earth in 2010: the first asteroid samples ever brought back.
suggestion.orbit: hovering beside Itokawa (as Hayabusa2 at Ryugu)
suggestion.ou_involvement: OU researchers study grains of Itokawa returned by Hayabusa (see Itokawa).
